messages:
maria: deploy-bot alerted on high 5xx for embed-service v2.3.0 in eu-west1. requesting expedited rollout of v2.3.1 (hotfix). tagging SRE + ops.

deploy-bot: alert: 2024-06-02T11:04:00Z - embed-service v2.3.0 error-rate 3.6% (eu-west1). recommend patch or rollback.

jonathan: oncall ack. starting triage. any infra/config changes in v2.3.1?

maria: no config/db changes. v2.3.1 = small binary patch to retry logic that caused transient 502s under bursts. image built and scanned.

security: image scan OK (no critical findings).

carol: docs needs 1-line changelog + link before signoff.

maria: changelog line: "Fix: race in retry path causing intermittent 502/504 under high concurrency. No config changes." link: https://internal.releases/embed/2.3.1

ben-ops: expedited rule: need rollback criteria + 3 approvals to skip extended canary. propose rollback if: (a) sustained error-rate > 1% for 5m, (b) p95 latency uplift > 300ms for 5m, or (c) client timeouts spike > 0.5%.

sre-oncall: agree. i'll own monitoring & rollback. posting runbook: /runbooks/embed-hotfix-rollback.md. fallback: revert in-region or shift to eu-east. autoscaler pinned.

maria: preflight OK. initiating: `/deploy release embed-service v2.3.1 --mode=express --ramp=10m`

deploy-bot: canary started (3 pods, eu-west1). metrics: https://metrics/embed/eu-west1/canary. awaiting 3 approvals to bypass extended canary.

maria: requesting quick approvals (3 needed). react :thumbsup: or reply.

carol: :thumbsup: docs attached.

product: :thumbsup: low-risk, high user impact.

ben-ops: :thumbsup: noted rollback thresholds.

deploy-bot: approve_count=3/3. schedule: 0->100% over 10m starting 2024-06-02T11:10:00Z.

sre-oncall: watching dashboards. will post metric snapshots every 2m. alerts enabled.

deploy-bot: ramp events: 25% @11:12, 50% @11:14, 75% @11:16, 100% @11:20.

sre-oncall: 11:14 snapshot: error-rate down to 0.3%, p95 stable. no client timeout spike. all green. :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks. continuing ramp.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: v2.3.1 active 100% in eu-west1 (2024-06-02T11:20:05Z).

sre-oncall: entering 10m post-deploy watch. will roll back if thresholds breached. so far 18m and stable.

maria: release notes posted: https://internal.releases/embed/2.3.1/notes
\maria: opening follow-up RL-4527 to add unit + stress tests for retry branch.

ben-ops: expedited window closed. please file postmortem if anything resurfaces.

maria: closing thread.
